name: Hoone
summary: Hoone is a daily arcade racing game played in the browser. Every day a new map is generated from the same seed for every player: a low-poly landscape with jumps, wall rides, river crossings, forks and risky shortcuts. Players race against the clock, try to set the fastest time and compare it on a global daily leaderboard. Runs are saved as ghosts, so players can race against their own best run or against other drivers' runs. Besides the daily map, players can race any map by its seed, unlock cars and paints through challenges, and watch replays of the top runs.
